get.summary: Displays the confirmation page to add a provider to a restricted course

parameters.name: larsCode
parameters.description: The LARS code of the course.

200.description: The confirmation page was successfully displayed.

302.description: Redirected to the restricted course details page if the session model is not found.

post.summary: Confirms and adds a provider to a restricted course

parameters.name: larsCode
parameters.description: The LARS code of the course.

302.description: Redirected to the restricted course details page after successful submission, or redirected back if the session model is not found.

400.description: Bad request if there were issues with the submission or other validation errors.

requestBody.description: This operation does not explicitly consume a body payload, but relies on route parameters and internal logic.
